title: Surrender at Ramna Racecourse
detail: Lieutenant General A. A. K. Niazi signed the instrument at Ramna Racecourse; Lieutenant General Jagjit Singh Aurora, GOC-in-C of the Indian and Bangladesh forces in the eastern theatre, accepted it. Banglapedia reports 5:01 p.m. without a time zone; a contemporaneous Indian parliamentary announcement gives 16:31 IST, while Keesing’s 1972 account gives 4:31 p.m. without a time zone. Accounts differ. Banglapedia identifies Group Captain A. K. Khandaker, deputy chief of staff of the Bangladesh forces, as representing the Mukti Bahini.
